decomposition.virtual_mode_policy: All prefix modes retained; no small symplectic mode frozen

info.scope: Ideal original-projector bound evaluated in float64; success mass is not fidelity; no full finite-precision sampler TV certificate

low_sector.scope: Bounds in exact arithmetic for the specified pure states, evaluated in complex128. Vacuum gap also lower-bounds zero-displacement threshold TV; other PNR bounds do not automatically transfer to threshold or displaced-mixture outputs.
